description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade scripts for certain hardware boards in the OpenWrt project, including functions to check image validity and perform upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A function that always returns success, indicating the image is valid.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: A function that performs the upgrade. It uses a case switch based on the board name to determine the upgrade process, handling specific boards with nand_do_upgrade and defaulting to default_do_upgrade.
